title: A DNA-Centric Mechanism for Protein Targeting in 6mA Methylation
one_liner_zh: 该文利用6mA体内数据结合语言模型与机器学习，从DNA视角解码蛋白-DNA识别逻辑，虽非直接TF-DNA体系，但方法可迁移至转录因子结合位点预测与互作机制研究。
abstract: How DNA-binding proteins locate specific genomic targets remains a central challenge in molecular biology. Traditional protein-centric approaches, which rely on wet-lab experiments and visualization techniques, often lack genome-wide resolution and fail to capture physiological dynamics in living cells. Here, we introduce a DNA-centric strategy that leverages in vivo N6-methyladenine (6mA) data to decode the logic of protein-DNA recognition. By integrating linguistically inspired modeling with machine learning, we reveal two distinct search modes: a protein-driven diffusion mechanism and a DNA sequence-driven mechanism, wherein specific motifs function as protein traps. We further reconstruct high-resolution interaction landscapes at the level of individual sequences and trace the evolutionary trajectories of recognition motifs across species. This framework addresses fundamental limitations of protein-centered approaches and positions DNA itself as an intrinsic reporter of protein-binding behavior.
abstract_zh: DNA结合蛋白如何定位特定的基因组靶点仍是分子生物学中的一个核心挑战。传统的以蛋白质为中心的方法依赖于湿实验和可视化技术，往往缺乏全基因组分辨率，且无法捕捉活细胞中的生理动态。在此，我们引入了一种以DNA为中心的策略，利用体内N6-甲基腺嘌呤（6mA）数据来解码蛋白质-DNA识别的逻辑。通过将语言学启发的建模与机器学习相结合，我们揭示了两种不同的搜索模式：一种是由蛋白质驱动的扩散机制，另一种是由DNA序列驱动的机制，其中特定基序充当蛋白质陷阱。我们进一步在单个序列水平上重建了高分辨率的相互作用图谱，并追踪了识别基序跨物种的进化轨迹。该框架解决了以蛋白质为中心的方法的根本局限性，并将DNA本身定位为蛋白质结合行为的内在报告器。
